item.title: Modest Inflation, Soft Spending Support Fed Hold
item.description: [Bloomberg] July’s personal income and outlays report indicates the underlying pace of inflation increased relatively modestly. Real spending also came in soft. Michael Ball, Macro Strategist with Bloomberg News, reacts to the PCE data. (Source: Bloomberg)
